code:
with date_spine as (
    {{ dbt_utils.date_spine(
        datepart="day",
        start_date="cast('2023-01-01' as date)",
        end_date="dateadd(day, 1, current_date())"
    ) }}
)

select mp.member_id, mp.status, ds.date_day as activity_date
from membership_periods mp
join date_spine ds
    on ds.date_day >= mp.status_start_date
   and ds.date_day <  mp.status_end_date_inclusive
caption: One row per member per day -- a pause now lands on its real date.

code:
row_number() over (
    partition by member_id, activity_date
    order by
        case when status = 'ACTIVE' then 0 else 1 end,
        membership_id desc
) as rn

-- keep only rn = 1: exactly one row per member per day
caption: A member at two locations the same day is still counted once.
